elements.requirement: An act done by a trade union to induce a person to take part, or continue to take part, in industrial action is not protected unless the industrial action has the support of a ballot.
elements.quote: is not protected unless the industrial action has the support of a ballot

elements.requirement: Where section 226A falls to be complied with in relation to a person's employer, an act done by a trade union to induce the person to take part, or continue to take part, in industrial action is not protected as respects that employer unless the trade union has complied with section 226A in relation to the employer.
elements.quote: is not protected as respects the employer unless the trade union has complied with section 226A in relation to him

elements.requirement: In section 226, the relevant time in relation to an act by a trade union to induce a person to take part, or continue to take part, in industrial action means the time at which proceedings are commenced in respect of the act.
elements.quote: means the time at which proceedings are commenced in respect of the act

elements.requirement: Industrial action shall be regarded as having the support of a ballot only if the trade union has held a ballot in respect of the action in relation to which the requirements of section 226ZA were satisfied.
elements.quote: in relation to which the requirements of section 226ZA were satisfied

elements.requirement: Industrial action shall be regarded as having the support of a ballot only if the trade union has held a ballot in respect of the action in relation to which the requirements of section 226B, so far as applicable before and during the holding of the ballot, were satisfied.
elements.quote: in relation to which the requirements of section 226B so far as applicable before and during the holding of the ballot were satisfied

elements.requirement: Industrial action shall be regarded as having the support of a ballot only if the trade union has held a ballot in respect of the action in relation to which the requirements of sections 227 to 231 and Schedule A1A, so far as applicable, were satisfied.
elements.quote: in relation to which the requirements of sections 227 to 231 and Schedule A1A, so far as applicable were satisfied

elements.requirement: Industrial action shall be regarded as having the support of a ballot only if the trade union has held a ballot in respect of the action in which at least 50% of those who were entitled to vote in the ballot did so.
elements.quote: in which at least 50% of those who were entitled to vote in the ballot did so

elements.requirement: Industrial action shall be regarded as having the support of a ballot only if the trade union has held a ballot in respect of the action in which the majority voting in the ballot answered 'Yes' to the question applicable in accordance with section 229(2) to industrial action of the kind to which the act of inducement relates.
elements.quote: in which the majority voting in the ballot answered “Yes" to the question applicable in accordance with section 229(2) to industrial action of the kind to which the act of inducement relates

elements.requirement: Industrial action shall be regarded as having the support of a ballot only if such of the requirements of section 226B (so far as applicable after the holding of the ballot) and section 231B as have fallen to be satisfied at the relevant time have been satisfied.
elements.quote: such of the requirements of the following sections as have fallen to be satisfied at the relevant time have been satisfied

elements.requirement: Industrial action shall be regarded as having the support of a ballot only if section 232A does not prevent the industrial action from being regarded as having the support of the ballot.
elements.quote: section 232A does not prevent the industrial action from being regarded as having the support of the ballot

elements.requirement: Industrial action shall be regarded as having the support of a ballot only if the requirements of section 233 regarding the calling of industrial action with the support of a ballot are satisfied.
elements.quote: the requirements of section 233 (calling of industrial action with support of ballot) are satisfied

elements.requirement: Any reference in section 226(2) to a requirement of a provision which is disapplied or modified by section 232 has effect subject to section 232.
elements.quote: Any reference in this subsection to a requirement of a provision which is disapplied or modified by section 232 has effect subject to that section.

elements.requirement: Where separate workplace ballots are held by virtue of section 228(1), industrial action shall be regarded as having the support of a ballot if the conditions specified in section 226(2) are satisfied in relation to the ballot for the place of work of the person induced to take part, or continue to take part, in the industrial action.
elements.quote: industrial action shall be regarded as having the support of a ballot if the conditions specified in subsection (2) are satisfied

elements.requirement: Where separate workplace ballots are held by virtue of section 228(1), the trade union shall be taken to have complied with the requirements relating to a ballot imposed by section 226A if those requirements are complied with in relation to the ballot for the place of work of the person induced to take part, or continue to take part, in the industrial action.
elements.quote: the trade union shall be taken to have complied with the requirements relating to a ballot imposed by section 226A if those requirements are complied with, in relation to the ballot for the place of work of the person induced to take part, or continue to take part, in the industrial action.

elements.requirement: If the requirements of section 231A fall to be satisfied in relation to an employer, industrial action shall not be regarded as having the support of a ballot as respects that employer unless those requirements are satisfied in relation to that employer.
elements.quote: as respects that employer industrial action shall not be regarded as having the support of a ballot unless those requirements are satisfied in relation to that employer

elements.requirement: For the purposes of section 226, an inducement in relation to a person includes an inducement which is or would be ineffective, whether because of that person's unwillingness to be influenced by it or for any other reason.
elements.quote: includes an inducement which is or would be ineffective, whether because of his unwillingness to be influenced by it or for any other reason
